issues.where: the lower-left fractured rock slope and recessed grey rock face in the top crop, also visible at full frame in set-B-01-b.png
issues.what: compression smears the crisp rock striations and fine stone texture into heavy, muddy, blurry blotches that stand out even at full-frame delivery size
issues.fix: raise bitrate and reduce aggressive deblocking or temporal smoothing so textured foreground rock retains sharp detail without smearing

issues.where: the dark overhanging rock ledge and adjacent cliff face in the bottom crop
issues.what: the dark rock overhang and surrounding ridges smear into blurry, blotchy patches with severe loss of surface texture and edge definition
issues.fix: allocate more bits to dark textured foregrounds and soften encoder filtering so rock ridges do not turn to mush

issues.where: the upper-left dark gnarled growth cluster clinging to the cliff in the top crop, and the lower clusters in set-B-04.png and set-B-05.png
issues.what: fine organic surface detail and jagged silhouettes collapse into mushy, smeared blobs with dark halos that will crawl during playback
issues.fix: increase bitrate and use psychovisual rate control tuned to preserve complex dark foreground detail

issues.where: the thin bright-edged translucent vapor ribbons and the orange-purple sunset sky above the horizon
issues.what: delicate bright ribbon edges break into smeared, blocky streaks while the sunset sky shows compression blocking and subtle banding across the warm gradient
issues.fix: encode in 10-bit at a higher bitrate with gentler quantization to preserve thin bright edges and smooth sky gradients

issues.where: the fine wispy translucent tendrils streaming right from the lower cluster in the bottom crop
issues.what: fine wispy vapor filaments dissolve into smeared, muddy streaks and lose clean separation against the sunset sky
issues.fix: increase bitrate and reduce temporal blur so fine translucent tendrils stay crisp against the background

issues.where: the dark purple storm clouds and folded vapor ribbon in the top crop, and the dark clouds in set-B-02.png
issues.what: subtle dark cloud texture flattens into visible compression blocks and blotchy patches, and delicate veining inside the vapor ribbon smears
issues.fix: use adaptive quantization tuned for dark skies and low-contrast vapour with lower quantization parameters so clouds do not block

issues.where: the overlapping translucent vapor membranes in the bottom crop and the purple cloud glow around the lightning in the top crop
issues.what: fine internal membrane lines smear and soften, and the purple lightning glow flattens into slightly stepped, blocky patches in the surrounding cloud
issues.fix: use 10-bit encoding with higher bitrate and preserve fine dithering so glow falloff and translucent layers remain smooth
